activeIndex.name: voice-index-v1
activeIndex.policy: New begin compacts validated terminal IDs; catalog independently retains terminal rows.

commit: Root operation transaction verifies exact immutable request/current match and existing terminal.
Stage exact original JSON snapshot and verify encrypted readback; verify existing sealed audio or encrypt exact provisional raw bytes without repairing header or creating manifest.
Ensure caller active immediately before sole catalog publication; acknowledge only after catalog and original audit readback.

Precommit known failure cleans only this attempt unpublished staging; unknown/postcommit failure preserves possible committed data; retry verifies original and returns checked acknowledgement without ciphertext writes.
invariants: Original ID, target, certificate, model, draft, text, creation time and known manifest cannot be retargeted. Codex historical account metadata follows existing RuntimeIdentity rules.

First terminal intent/audit/raw evidence is immutable; mutable attempt flags and later phase/expiresAt may update current original only. Existing store never persisted full returned transcript/error in its recording row; no reconstruction is claimed.
Restore filters valid terminal; invalid catalog/original audit throws instead of offering. Seal rejects terminal before touching raw file. Terminal remove does nothing.

Original encrypted WAV or inline audio, pending phase/expiry, exact audit text and provisional raw file remain retained; no prepare/upload/cancel/replay or replacement recording occurs in this adapter.
A provisional request can match the same original sealed before the owner obtains backend lock; marker retains the first request fingerprint/manifestKnown.
Absent/empty/raw provisional evidence is portable only behind a terminal and with no prepare/audio attempt or remote phase; active provisional remains unsupported.

migration.pipeline: Existing encrypted export, graph validation, candidate and generation activation only
migration.voiceRows: Union of active index and terminal catalog; orphan audit/raw/missing/mismatch rejects entire archive
migration.activation: Original audit/catalog/binary stay exact; current voice row gets existing migrationReadOnly flag; no terminal is executable authority
migration.limits: Existing 8MiB text, 21MiB blob, 192MiB aggregate and 256MiB envelope limits unchanged; 256 terminals does not promise 256 maximum-size audio files fit.

scope: Storage only; parent binds exact current restored session/store and deduplicates narrow port. Owner must stop/join old work before calling; failed/timeout acknowledgement cannot start replacement. No Controller/MobileSession/UI changes here.

status.native: 12 methods compiled only, device/PID execution remains coordinator responsibility
status.fullMigration: open: EasyWork device authority/fence and nonempty foreground v1 journal are unsupported; no best-effort omission
